# Quality bar

Seven frames from each reference film (downscaled). Use them to judge whether a new film's
look-dev and preview are in the same quality class — never to copy their stories, characters,
products or layouts. `worldforge.jpg` = Mars, `worldforge-roma.jpg` = Rome, `paperworld.jpg` is from a
540×960 preview, `characterflow.jpg` = three campus frames and four bedroom-at-night frames from two
CHARACTER FLOW validation films directed automatically from a voice-over, `panelverse.jpg` = seven frames of the PANELVERSE reference film "Oke" (punch zoom, freeze panel, 3-up page, diagonal split, TAMAT!, the reveal, the end page). These stills are the author's original renders
and are included only as references.
